name: Surge arrester
summary: A surge arrester diverts a documented surge-related current through its protective path.
description: A surge arrester diverts a documented surge-related current through its protective path. Its system connection, rating and earthing lead arrangement are essential drawing information.
readingNotes: Trace the protected conductor and discharge path independently.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A surge arrester limits overvoltage transients; it does not replace overcurrent interruption.
